resources.string: Recipes, meal plans and shopping lists from your own Tandoor server.
Browse your Tandoor recipes and cook step by step.
Meal plan and shopping list, shared with your household.
Tandem talks only to your own Tandoor. No ads, no tracking.
Tandem is an unofficial app for Tandoor Recipes.
Enter the address you use to open Tandoor in your browser.
https:// is added if you leave it out. If Tandoor runs under a path, include it, e.g. example.com/tandoor.
Tandoor %1$s has not been tested yet
Tandem is tested with Tandoor 2.6. You can continue, but the app starts in safe mode: you can read everything, and changes are held back until a tested version of Tandem is available.
Tandem needs Tandoor 2.0 or newer. Ask whoever runs the server to update it, then try again.
The server asks for a login first

1. Get the CA certificate (a .crt or .pem file) from whoever runs the server.
2. On this phone, open Settings and search for “CA certificate”, or go to Security and privacy → More security settings → Install from device storage → CA certificate. Menu names differ between phone makers.
3. Pick the file, come back and tap Connect again.
Tandem never turns off certificate checks: that would let others read your login.

Something in front of Tandoor, such as a firewall, CrowdSec or a login portal (Authentik, Authelia), stopped the app. Tandem must reach /api/, /api-token-auth/ and /media/ directly, without a browser login.
Use the same address you open Tandoor with in the browser. If Tandoor runs under a path, include it, for example https://example.com/tandoor.
If the server is only reachable from home, connect to your home Wi-Fi or VPN and try again.
Tandoor Recipes is free software that you run yourself. Try Tandem with sample data first, or see how to get started.
How to get started with Tandoor

Tandoor Recipes is a free, open-source recipe manager. You install it on your own server, a NAS or a small home computer, usually with Docker. The official documentation explains every step. When it runs, come back here and enter its address.
Use your Tandoor username and password.
You stay logged in on this device. Your password is never saved.
Paste an API token from your Tandoor account.
In Tandoor in the browser, open Settings → API and create a new token with the scope “read write”. Create one token per device, so you can remove it later without logging out your other devices.
Check both and try again. Tandoor allows 10 login attempts per day, failed ones included.
Tandoor allows 10 login attempts per day from your network, failed ones included. Try again later, or paste an API token instead.

resources.string: It may be mistyped, expired or deleted. Create a new token in Tandoor under Settings → API.
Your account has no space yet
Log in to Tandoor in the browser once to create or join a space, then try again.
Password sign-in to Tandoor 2.7 isn’t supported yet
Tandem can’t yet sign in with a password on Tandoor 2.7 and later. Choose “Paste a token instead” and use an API token from Settings → API in Tandoor.
The login could not be saved
Secure storage on this device is not available right now, so Tandem cannot keep you logged in. Restart the phone and try again.
Tandem has not been tested with Tandoor %1$s yet. Reading works as usual; changes are held back until a tested version of Tandem is available.
